title: Support trackALAlertsInGitHub for workspace compilation build path
summary: AL-Go now produces error log files during workspace compilation when GitHub code scanning alerts are enabled, allowing AL compiler diagnostics to surface as code scanning alerts in the workspace build path.
key_points: Error log directory argument passed to altool workspace compile when trackALAlertsInGitHub is enabled
Each project generates errorLog.json diagnostics file into .buildartifacts/ErrorLogs/ folder
Gracefully skips --errorlogdirectory if compiler does not support it with a warning
Matches existing behavior from classic Run-AlPipeline build path
quote: AL-Go passes `--errorlogdirectory` to `altool workspace compile` so each project emits an `*.errorLog.json` diagnostics file
